newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Beef remains strong but futures showing topping action with back months turning technically weak.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Index up slightly but corn futures continue to rise.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Cash hog markets seen steady to lower as packer kill rates remain down.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.250 to up 0.250 cent. Further rolling of longs seen. Delivery concerns remain in August to offset strong cash while February closed limit up on Wednesday.
